description: This file defines the RichText class in the PhpSpreadsheet library, handling rich text elements within spreadsheet cells, including creation, manipulation, and cloning of rich text content.

classes.name: RichText
classes.description: Represents rich text content in a spreadsheet cell, allowing creation, modification, and retrieval of styled text elements.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of RichText, optionally attaching it to a cell and replicating its style.

methods.name: addText
methods.description: Adds a text element to the rich text object.

methods.name: createText
methods.description: Creates a new TextElement with specified text and adds it to the rich text object.

methods.name: createTextRun
methods.description: Creates a new Run object with specified text and adds it to the rich text object.

methods.name: getPlainText
methods.description: Returns all the text content of the rich text object as a plain string.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: String representation of the rich text object, returning the plain text content.

methods.name: getRichTextElements
methods.description: Retrieves the array of text elements.

methods.name: setRichTextElements
methods.description: Sets the array of text elements.

methods.name: getHashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code representing the combined state of the text elements.

methods.name: __clone
methods.description: Performs a deep clone of the RichText object, ensuring all internal objects are cloned.
